# Data Integrity & Concurrency Checklist: Issues — creation, detail and editing

**Purpose**: Validate that the numbering, invariant, transaction and concurrency requirements in `spec.md` are complete, unambiguous and objectively verifiable, before the feature is decomposed into tasks
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/mutators.md](../contracts/mutators.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

This is a **requirements-quality** review, not a verification pass. Every item asks whether something is *written well*, not whether code *works*.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the constraint that the composite foreign key depends on — a uniqueness guarantee over the project-and-column pair on the referenced table — stated as a requirement, or discovered only at planning? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the case where a project's issue-counter row is absent when a creation runs? [Gap, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the shape of the issue-counter row this feature reads specified anywhere a reviewer of R5 would encounter it? [Gap, Spec §FR-013, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the base case for the ordering index specified — what value creation writes when the project holds no issue at all? [Gap, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the transaction isolation level, or the guarantee it must provide, stated for any of the three mutators? [Gap, Spec §FR-039, §FR-055, §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for what a caller sees when a write is refused by a database constraint rather than by a mutator's own check? [Gap, Spec §FR-050]
- [ ] CHK007 Is it specified whether a creation that fails after drawing a number consumes that number or returns it? [Gap, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 Is "the response MUST carry the settled state" defined precisely enough to distinguish a conforming response from a non-conforming one? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "what each differs from" specified as to form and audience — a value the mutator holds, a value it returns, or a value it records? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the 200-character title bound stated in units a reviewer can apply unambiguously to combining marks, astral-plane characters and emoji? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified whether the length bound applies before or after the trim that `FR-030` requires? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "one transaction" stated consistently as one database transaction rather than one logical operation, everywhere the phrase appears? [Clarity, Spec §FR-039, §FR-055, §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "under a row lock" specific enough to exclude an implementation that reads and then writes without holding the lock across both? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the three mutators' transaction requirements now read alike, or does one still describe its transaction in materially different terms from the other two? [Consistency, Spec §FR-039, §FR-055, §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the ordering requirements consistent — does exactly one requirement claim to be the only ordering write in this feature, with no second requirement implying another? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040, §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the immutability requirements agree across every statement of them — project, number, creator and ordering index named identically in each? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-011, §FR-012, §FR-055]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the cascade requirement agree with the delete-transaction requirement about where the cascade is enforced, with neither implying the mutator body performs it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-057, §FR-058, §FR-059]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can "two issues in one project never hold the same number" be objectively verified under concurrency, and does the criterion say what concurrency it must survive? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Is there a measurable criterion for "no caller ever observes a partially deleted issue", stating from what vantage point the observation is made? [Measurability, Spec §SC-011]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the no-op-write criterion stated in terms a test can assert without depending on an implementation detail of how the timestamp is written? [Measurability, Spec §SC-018]
- [ ] CHK021 Are the structural requirements accompanied by a stated method of verification, given that no user journey observes them? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-001…§FR-008]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are concurrent-edit requirements stated as a requirement rather than only as an assumption and an edge-case bullet, given that no functional requirement or success criterion covers them? [Gap, Spec §Assumptions, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for a column deleted concurrently with a save that moves an issue into it? [Gap, Spec §FR-052]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for the boundary values of each bound — exactly at the limit, and one past it — rather than only for "past its length bound"? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for a due date at the extremes a calendar date admits, or is the accepted range stated as unbounded deliberately? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the interaction between deletion and numbering covered by both a requirement and a criterion, rather than by an edge-case bullet alone? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, §SC-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Is the assumption that R5 has already created the counter row for every project stated where this feature depends on it? [Assumption, Spec §Inherited constraints]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the assumption that persistence tests run against a real database, rather than a mock, stated as a constraint on how these requirements can be satisfied? [Assumption, Spec §Inherited constraints]
- [ ] CHK029 Are the cascade arms later entries will attach enumerated precisely enough that each entry's author can identify its own without re-reading §4? [Dependency, Spec §FR-059]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK001, CHK003 and CHK005 are answered in [data-model.md](../data-model.md) and [research.md](../research.md) A-3, A-7 and B-5. That the answers exist is not the same as the requirement being specified — decide deliberately whether each belongs in the spec
